parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1250417. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL1250417, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return rows ordered by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
